levels.name: INFORMATIONAL
levels.description: Routine diagnostic events, heartbeat signals, and healthy system status changes with zero operational impact.

levels.name: LOW
levels.description: Low-priority anomalous traffic, baseline deviations, or noisy automated scans absorbed by edge perimeter controls.

levels.name: MEDIUM
levels.description: Suspicious internal activity, failed authentication thresholds, unverified external senders, or package state drifts.

levels.name: HIGH
levels.description: Confirmed threat intelligence hits from reputation feeds, known offensive tool hashes, or targeted exploit payloads.

levels.name: CRITICAL
levels.description: Active remote code execution attempts, confirmed credential stuffing, malware execution bypasses, or C2 handshakes.

levels.name: EMERGENCY
levels.description: Enterprise-wide compromise, domain controller privilege elevation, or confirmed multi-host lateral movement.
